title: A Study to Evaluate the Safety of Rosuvastatin in Children and Adolescents With Homozygous Familial Hypercholesterolemia

sections.abstract:
The purpose of the study is to evaluate the safety of Rosuvastatin in Children and Adolescents with Homozygous Familial Hypercholesterolemia.

Posted outcomes: The Number of Participants Who Experianced Adverse Events and Serious Adverse Events. timeframe=96 weeks. Full Analysis Set=5
